3799.note_text: Metrological supervision includes checking the correctness of the quantities indicated on and contained in prepackages.

3797.note_text: control exercised in respect of the manufacture, import, installation, use, maintenance and repair of a measuring instrument and/or in respect of its use, performed in order to check that it is used correctly as regards the observance of metrology laws and regulations [VIML, 2.3]
